Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In step 11, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the IMDb search results snippet (which showed "1904–1992") as the definitive source for the birth year. The Planner introduced a flawed "industry-source precedence rule," claiming that IMDb's listing of 1904 should override the consistent 1901 dates found in Britannica and Wikipedia. This was a hallucination of a rule not present in the task instructions and ignored the fact that the specific IMDb search results page visible to the WebSurfer did not explicitly display the birth year 1904 in the text provided; it only showed the name and a link, while the actual person page (which was later incorrectly navigated to in step 8) is where such data typically resides. By prioritizing this erroneous interpretation, the Planner steered the conversation toward the wrong answer (1904) instead of confirming the well-documented 1901 birth year supported by multiple reliable sources.
